name: JD Feudal aggro/rush vs Ranged FC civ
author: resdxcvi

notes: @resource/rally.webp@ next @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on  @resource/sheep.webp@ then the next on @resource/resource_gold.webp@,  @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ @resource/deer.webp@.

Send new @unit_worker/villager.webp@to @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ next 2 to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. *If rushed before 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, use @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.webp@ to block @resource/resource_gold.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@*.

Go @age/age_2.webp@ @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.webp@ with only @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.webp@. Send 5 @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to  @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_economy/mill.webp@ on  @resource/deer.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@1 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ + 2 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@. (Use @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to guard @resource/resource_food.webp@ or @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@).

@resource/rally.webp@ next 2 to @resource/resource_food.webp@+ @resource/resource_gold.webp@. *If you were dark age aggro'd*  @abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@ with the @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ 1st.

Get @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@+ @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@, then just pump @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ respectively. @abilities/repair.webp@2nd @building_economy/house.webp@ with @resource/resource_gold.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@.

@age/age_2.webp@ complete, Get @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/stable.webp@ . Move 3 off @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to 2 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + 1 on @resource/resource_food.webp@. Produce @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ and get @technology_french/chivalry.webp@ after first que. Lock off enemy side @resource/resource_food.webp@ or @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@+ @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms-2.webp@ for XP.
Opt for 11 @resource/resource_food.webp@, 10 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and no more than 8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, then pump @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to 6, maintain ratio.
